sources.name: ArchDaily
sources.summary: Set within 51 hectares of cork oak and umbrella pine forest in Comporta, Sublime Comporta Sand marks the next chapter of one of Portugal’s most recognisable hospitality destinations. Designed by Lisbon-based studio Fragmentos, the project unfolds as both a continuation and a quiet reinvention of the existing Sublime Comporta.
